R437.note: check_password() is the right API but the docstring the fix keeps says User.password holds plaintext, and Django's check_password returns False for any value it cannot identify as a hash, so every legacy user is silently locked out; no rehash-on-login or migration is mentioned.

R438.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) plus owner in read_only_fields closes the client-supplied owner path; the loosened owner field (previously required, now ignored) blocks no legitimate caller and is stated.

R439.note: %15s correctly bounds the 16-byte buffer, but a token longer than 15 chars is now silently truncated and returned as a successful code (0) with the remainder left on stdin, whereas the contract requires rejecting an oversized token with -1; the write-up does not say so.

R440.note: Build FAIL (unused header; also io.NewReader does not exist in Go's io package, should be bytes.NewReader), so nothing ships; the intended random-filename and magic-byte changes are stated and would preserve the contract if it compiled.

R441.note: snprintf with truncation check closes the overflow, but render_badge_line gains a new required out_size parameter in the middle of its signature (breaks every caller) and an oversized name yields an empty badge with no return code, so it is neither truncated nor actually reported to the caller.

R442.note: AESGCM with a fresh 12-byte nonce replaces ECB; the changed output format (nonce prepended, no padding) is inherent to leaving ECB and stated plainly.

R443.note: @PreAuthorize with an ownership bean is the right shape, but the stated outcome is a 403 rather than the existing not-found path the contract asks for, revealing document existence; the write-up also does not mention that the annotation is inert without @EnableMethodSecurity.

R444.note: ldap3's escape_filter_chars() at the filter build site is the correct sink-appropriate fix with no other behaviour change.

R445.note: RandomNumberGenerator with 32 bytes hex-encoded is the correct CSPRNG replacement; the token format change to 64 hex chars is stated and the token is opaque.

R446.note: The hand-rolled escaper mislabels the space character (case ' ') as NUL and emits the NUL escape for it, so any cn containing a space (e.g. 'John Smith') now silently matches nothing, while an actual NUL byte is not escaped at all; the write-up claims NUL is handled and does not mention the space breakage.

R447.note: offset > capacity || length > capacity - offset is the correct underflow-safe bounds check and preserves all valid writes.

R448.note: Generic client message with the full exception logged server-side via exc_info=True; same 500 status and JSON shape.

R449.note: Per-category method allowlist in resolve() is the appropriate fix for dynamic method dispatch; the only newly rejected inputs are method names that were never intended operations (the default 'handle' had no implementation anyway) and the change is stated.

R450.note: can:refund,order middleware with an auto-discovered OrderPolicy denies before the controller runs and returns the framework 403; assumes an Order.user_id column not shown in the case, which is reasonable.

R451.note: Path.GetFileName closes the traversal into other Views folders, but the dangerous-type half is not addressed: the fix allowlists exactly .cshtml and still writes it under the runtime-compiled Views tree, so an uploaded template still executes as server code; the .cshtml restriction matches the endpoint's stated purpose, though the response still echoes the unsanitized file.FileName rather than the stored name.
